title: 第535章 戴着面具围攻小灰灰的生物
slug: 规则怪谈从诡异哆啦a梦开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

如果是小灰灰的心脏，那么这次的怪谈游戏应该就要落入尾声了。

毕竟按照怪谈游戏以往的作风，小灰灰的心脏应该就是关键。

可是......今天只是林远进入喜羊羊与灰太狼怪谈的第三天。

第四天都未到来，就可以下定这个结论吗？

忽地，林远睁大了双眼。

骑士国龙皓晨给他的话，是让他明天去青山墓地说的。

也就是说......龙皓晨知道怪谈游戏会安排他明天去青山墓地？

为什么他会知道怪谈游戏的进程？

还是说，龙皓晨已经被杰克操纵了，故意给他挖的坑，让他去试水？

林远摇了摇头：

“不对，杰克的社交平台在出发前也没有发布过去往骑士国的消息。”

“他如果有这种心思，断不可能让龙皓晨活下来。”

“更别说，让他引诱自己与新来的住户说话了。”

林远皱了皱眉头，隐隐觉得龙皓晨有些不对劲。

按照龙国的提示，龙皓晨之所以能活下来，是他一直在巴结这些诡异，甚至在危机时刻，还掏出了能麻痹诡异的诡器。

所以......他在上一次通关怪谈游戏获得了能预知的道具？

这一次，比我先行一步，找到了类似板砖效果的诡器？

可这么想也不对啊，如果获得了稀有诡器，天幕播报的时候会顺带一提的。

虽然不会直接讲出诡器的具体使用能力，但至少也会说获得了诡器。

在熊出没怪谈游戏中通关的天选者并不少，却只有龙皓晨获得诡器，这是为什么？

林远喃喃自语道：

“不得不说，我倒是真想见见这位骑士国的天选者了。”

“会突然说龙国话，又能找到别样的生路......真是和我有些相似啊。”

林远倒是希望，这龙皓晨也是穿越者。

至少这样，他不再是一个人与怪谈游戏战斗了。

红太狼端着空盘子从楼上走了下来，看到林远已经吃完了蛋炒饭，开心地打算收走盘子。

“别动，老婆。”

红太狼刚打算收走林远面前的空盘，就被林远阻拦了下来。

“怎么了，老公？”

林远看向红太狼的眼睛，觉得现在还不是一个合适的时机。

于是他按照灰太狼一贯的语气说道：

“洗碗这种事，怎么能交给我美丽动人的老婆呢？”

“这种事，都是我灰太狼的。”

红太狼看了林远一眼，眼睛里满是愉快。

“老公，你真好。”

红太狼放下了盘子，有些撒娇起来。

林远满脸殷勤：

“不是我好，是我们家红红好。”

“因为红红值得呀。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

If it is Xiao Huihui's heart, then this ghost story game should be coming to an end.

After all, according to the past style of Kaitan Games, Xiao Huihui's heart should be the key.

But... today is only the third day that Lin Yuan has entered into the conversation between Pleasant Goat and Big Big Wolf.

The fourth day has not yet come, can we draw this conclusion?

Suddenly, Lin Yuan opened his eyes wide.

The words given to him by Long Haochen of the Knight Kingdom were to be told at Qingshan Cemetery tomorrow.

In other words... Long Haochen knew that Kaitan Games would arrange for him to go to Qingshan Cemetery tomorrow?

Why does he know the progress of the Kaitan Game?

Or is it that Long Haochen has been manipulated by Jack and deliberately dug a hole for him to test the waters?

Lin Yuan shook his head:

"No, Jack's social platform didn't post any news about his trip to Knight Country before departure."

"If he had this kind of intention, he would never be able to let Long Haochen survive."

"Not to mention, let him seduce me into talking to the new residents."

Lin Yuan frowned, vaguely feeling that something was wrong with Long Haochen.

According to Long Guo's prompts, the reason why Long Haochen was able to survive was that he had been fawning over these weird things, and even in times of crisis, he even took out a strange weapon that could paralyze weird things.

So...he got a predictable item when he cleared the Kaidan game last time?

This time, you were one step ahead of me and found a trick with a brick-like effect?

But it’s not right to think so. If you obtain a rare artifact, it will be mentioned in passing during the broadcast.

Although the specific ability to use the trick weapon will not be directly stated, it will at least be said that the trick weapon has been obtained.

There are many chosen ones who have passed the level of the game "The Legend of Bears", but only Long Haochen has obtained the Artifact. Why is this?

Lin Yuan murmured to himself:

"I have to say, I really want to meet this chosen one from the Kingdom of Knights."

"He can suddenly speak Longguo dialect and find other ways to survive... He is really similar to me."

Lin Yuan hoped that Long Haochen was also a time traveler.

At least this way, he no longer fights Kaidan Yugi alone.

Red Wolf walked downstairs with an empty plate. Seeing that Lin Yuan had finished the egg fried rice, he happily planned to take the plate away.

"Don't move, wife."

Just as Red Wolf was about to take away the empty plate in front of Lin Yuan, he was stopped by Lin Yuan.

"What's wrong, husband?"

Lin Yuan looked into Red Wolf's eyes and felt that now was not the right time.

So he said according to Big Big Wolf's usual tone:

"How can I leave washing dishes to my beautiful wife?"

"This kind of thing belongs to me, Big Big Wolf."

Red Wolf glanced at Lin Yuan, his eyes full of joy.

"Husband, you are so kind."

Red Wolf put down the plate and became a little bit coquettish.

Lin Yuan's face was full of hospitality:

"It's not my fault, it's our family's fault."

"Because Honghong is worth it."
